lessons: merge.py wiring and the composition tests are acceptable, so keep them. Review failed a third time for the same gap: acceptance criteria 3, 4 and 6 have no tests. Do not report Outcome ok until every criterion has a test.

AC3: in a real git fixture, commit tickets/<stem>/ticket.md with a ## Verification section and an approve review.md. Call compose_pipeline(...).merge_queue.admit(Candidate). Assert the squash trailer carries the reviewed SHA.

AC3 red path: a failing ## Verification command must leave main unmoved and create no squash commit. Assert the Verification commands ran in candidate.worktree, for example with a command that writes a marker file there.

AC4, through the concrete adapters: (a) main moved after review and a fresh pin, so it integrates; (b) a stale reviewed_sha and (c) a missing review.md are refused and main is unchanged; (d) main unchanged with ORIG_HEAD deleted or stale still integrates.

For success, refusal, exception and cancellation, assert admission_state is empty, both through the real adapters and with the existing fake-callback test. Read mergequeue.py to see how an exception raised from integrate unwinds.

AC6: remove the inspect.getsource string asserts. Drive the real __main__ _locked factory and Runner.dispatch. Use monkeypatch to wrap, not replace, compose_pipeline so it records the pipeline, and stub Pipeline.run. Then assert isinstance(recorded.merge_queue, MergeQueue).
reason: Third attempt reported ok in about 12 minutes while the same test criteria were still missing, even though prior lessons named each one. More capability is needed to finish the real-git adapter tests and the Runner-level test.
